dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Awesome! This little street of eateries is pretty similar to Chihu Rock, but if you look closer, there are a lot of differences, too!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Let's go look at different restaurants together and see what makes each place unique, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: After that, I'll open another Wanmin Restaurant right here!
